rooms.name: Shrine Descent
rooms.scene: Roadstone steps descend beneath the candle rail. A Road Trial Oath is carved above the first landing.

rooms.name: Hall of Threaded Names
rooms.scene: Thread tags hang from the ceiling. Some names are old. Some are still wet with wax.

rooms.name: Broken Bell Niche
rooms.scene: A cracked wall niche holds half a bell. Amber wax gutters through a broken seal channel.

rooms.name: Pilgrim Bone Walk
rooms.scene: The passage narrows into three visible lanes. Bones shift beneath the floor like a bad idea learning to crawl.

rooms.name: Candleless Alcove
rooms.scene: One alcove has no candle, no soot, and no dust. Even the dark seems careful around it.

rooms.name: Warden Chamber
rooms.scene: A cracked bronze bell hangs from roots over a circular roadstone floor. The Bellgrave Warden waits beneath it.

rooms.name: Road-Seal Exit
rooms.scene: The exit bell finally rings outward. The road above remembers you stood your ground.
